details: माननीय अध्यक्ष महोदय, चूँकि माननीय सदस्य का प्रश्न मूल प्रश्न और मूल मंत्रालय, दोनों से संबंधित नहीं है, लेकिन मैं सिर्फ इतना निवेदन करना चाहता हूँ that the responsibility of execution of such projects and tourism circuits lies on the shoulders of the States. records.title: Kochi- Bengaluru Industrial Corridor
details: a to d: As part of the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP), an Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) at Palakkad in the State of Kerala as part of extension of Chennai Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC) has been approved by the Government of India in August 2024. A Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), namely "Kerala Industrial Corridor Development Corporation Limited" has been incorporated for the implementation of the project.

records.title: Vacancy in National Medical Commission
details: (a) to (c): As informed by National Medical Commission (NMC), as of now, there are a total of 19 vacant posts in the NMC and its Autonomous Boards. For filling up of these vacant posts, advertisements were published in National daily newspapers on 31.08.2024 and 11.10.2024. Further, a Search-cum-Selection Committee for appointment of office bearers of the Commission has been constituted under the Chairmanship of Cabinet Secretary.
